html:
Behind the scenes this week, we cleared a snag that was quietly blocking one of our download sources, so new titles can reach the library faster. We also closed a sneaky bug that could leave a re-added movie stuck looking worse than it should, and rolled out a fresh batch of automated health checks that keep watch around the clock so problems get caught before they ever reach your screen.

A few more reliability tune-ups round things out. 🔧
